entities.name: Signs
entities.description: Regulations and standards related to signage in the city, including signage placement, size, and content to ensure safety, accessibility, and aesthetic consistency.

entities.name: Zoning Code
entities.description: Legal framework governing land use, building regulations, and spatial organization within the city to promote organized development and land utilization.

entities.name: Real Estate
entities.description: Activities, regulations, and market conditions related to buying, selling, leasing, and managing property within the city.

entities.name: Compliance Requirements
entities.description: Legal standards and regulations that entities must adhere to, including those set by the Department of Business Professional Regulation (DBPR) and other agencies, affecting business operations and real estate activities.

entities.name: Impact on Commercial Real Estate
entities.description: Effects of regulations, signage, and compliance requirements on the commercial real estate market, including leasing, marketing, and business location decisions.

entities.name: Walkability
entities.description: The measure of how friendly an area is to walking, including factors like signage, sidewalk quality, and proximity of amenities, influencing urban livability and business accessibility.

entities.name: Parking
entities.description: Regulations, availability, and management of parking facilities within the city, impacting traffic flow, accessibility, and urban planning.
